events.title: Accept alliance ?
events.text: "We need not be enemies, my child. Why not sign this treaty I have prepared and let our interests join, that we should both be the stronger for it."

events.title: Accept alliance ?
events.text: "My son, you rule your people with strength and honor. Why not bind your fate with that of the Church?  An alliance could strengthen you and me alike."
